coverage.note: Later-pass discovery used Vietnamese given-name tokens Huong, Thuy, Hieu, Linh, Quynh, Huyen, Nhu, Quyen, Bich, Duc, Khanh, Tram, Phuong, Uyen, Minh, Hanh, Nhat, Diep, Quoc, Phuoc, Chau, Tuong, Hao, Suong, Tien, Tung, Thanh, Thien, Triet, Hau, Phong and Huy; less-common surname searches included Kieu, Vuong, Cao, Luong, Nghiem, Khuu, Quach, Buu, Ta, Luu and Chu. Chemistry, physics/astronomy, geology, earth, atmospheric and oceanography combinations were searched. Search results supplied leads only. Stopped after repeated low-yield searches and seven verified new candidates; this is broad targeted coverage, not a claim that every US department was enumerated. Compared employer labels in earlier w1 codex coverage: Reed, Lamar and Florida Southern had no exact employer coverage label. Already-proposed names were screened out. No LinkedIn pages were fetched, no login used, and no roster/GitHub changes made.
